description: Wire format of the durable goal continuation control message, shared by nac-core (crates/nac-core/src/commands/goal_continuation.rs) and the web client (crates/nac-server/web/src/app/features/goals/continuation.ts). The message is {open}{goal_id}{header}{objective}\n{budget line}{instructions}. Display surfaces show only the goal identity and objective; a message shaped like the envelope that does not parse collapses to the generic label, and anything else is ordinary text. Vectors with a prompt are what the Rust builder writes for those inputs.

vectors.name: unlimited
vectors.message:
<nac_goal_continuation goal_id="0b7c1f3e-4f0a-4d5e-9a51-6f1f8f0c2a10">
Continue autonomously pursuing this durable goal:
ship the embedded MVP
No token budget was set.
Use get_goal when you need current accounting. Mark it complete only when the objective is genuinely achieved with no required work remaining. Mark it blocked only at a genuine impasse; otherwise finish this turn with a concise progress update and NAC will continue it.
</nac_goal_continuation>
